newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy prelim June CPI seen at 1.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy prelim June CPI seen at 1.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italy's June consumer prices index is forecast at 1.5 percent year on year, according to analysts' forecasts after five sample cities' data released on Friday.
This compares with a year-on-year rate of 1.6 percent and a month-on-month rise of 0.3 percent in May.
Analysts had forecast June inflation to stand at 0.2 percent month-on-month and 1.5-1.6 percent year-on-year.

A further six sample Italian cities, Turin, Venice, Bologna, Perigia, Naples and Palermo, release their data on Monday June 23, while statistics institute ISTAT will announce the final June figures on July 4.
